interval_years.quote: A certificate of license expires on the last day of the twenty-fourth month following its issuance or renewal and becomes invalid on that date unless renewed.

requirements.value: Reciprocity exists with some states. Applicants from non-reciprocal states must apply in writing and meet standard requirements. Masonry contractors must pass the masonry examination regardless of reciprocity.
requirements.quote: Notwithstanding any reciprocity for contractors which may otherwise exist between states, any person desiring to perform contracting services in this state as a licensed masonry contractor whether residing in this state or another state shall not be authorized to perform any such services unless the person takes and passes the masonry examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for home improvement fraud under § 39-14-154
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board shall revoke the license of any contractor, home improvement contractor or home improvement services provider upon receiving notification from the court in accordance with § 39-14-154(d) of such person's conviction for a violation of § 39-14-154.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Faulty electrical work performed by a limited licensed electrician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board for licensing contractors may revoke or suspend the license of a limited licensed electrician for faulty electrical work performed by the licensee.

bonding_required.quote: No person shall be required to post a bond, provide a financial statement or provide a letter of reference in order to obtain a license as a limited licensed electrician.

insurance_required.quote: The application shall also be accompanied by evidence of the applicant's current workers' compensation insurance coverage. Failure to provide evidence of insurance coverage shall make the applicant ineligible for licensure by the board until evidence of insurance coverage is provided.

definition_quote.value: Electrical construction is one of the nine major construction classifications in which a contractor may apply for a license. A 'limited licensed electrician' means any person or entity that performs any electrical work that has a total cost of less than twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) and that is required to be registered under § 68-102-150.

qualifier_required.quote: Corporations and partnerships may engage in the business of contracting; provided, that at least one (1) of the major stockholders or partners or full-time employees with a written power of attorney to bind the corporation or partnership has sufficient knowledge of the construction business in which the persons are licensed to perform.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: If the person who took the examination for the partnership or corporation leaves the firm for any reason, the partnership or corporation must designate an individual to take the examination within three (3) months.

small_project_dollar_threshold_exemption.quote: "Contractor" means any person or entity that undertakes to, attempts to or submits a price or bid or offers to construct... for which the total cost is twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000) or more

Failure to provide evidence of insurance coverage shall make the applicant ineligible for licensure by the board until evidence of insurance coverage is provided.

public_liability_insurance_required.quote: Any application for initial licensure or for renewal of licensure also shall be accompanied by an affidavit affirming that the applicant maintains general liability insurance and workers' compensation insurance and specifying the amount of the insurance
